invoke.body: <=1048576 bytes; JSON if parseable, otherwise UTF-8 text, empty => null; query values are strings
invoke.success: every 2xx: owned status/contentType/raw bytes; empty body allowed
invoke.failure: every non-2xx: TerraBaseFunctionInvocationException.Response preserves status/contentType/raw body; inherited ErrorCode parses error.code when available; includes 3xx, 401/403, 400/404/413/500 function_error/503; no redirect or retry
invoke.partial: cancellation/transport loss may leave effects committed; never replay automatically
invoke.contentTypes: producer emits application/json or text/plain; charset=utf-8; SDK does not decode or assume JSON

observationSemantics: JSON direct arrays; logs newest first, limit 1..100 default 50, last 100 retained; no cursor. Non-2xx use normal TerraBase exceptions.
